helperInterface.createResolutionSession: Synchronous factory({root,limits,onProduct}); root canonical absolute, limits combine existing hard acquisition caps and reduced new caps; trusted engine validates pinned runtime. Throws closed UNKNOWN_... errors without FD/PID/procpaths in errors. onProduct(file,from) records known product via logical root-relative targets; do not read product or foreign content to classify.
helperInterface.read: session.read(canonicalRootRelativeFile) -> {bytes:Buffer,text:string,sha256,stat:bigint-fstat}; anchored nofollow bounded strictUTF8; each physical file charged once, cache/revalidation. Internal metadata reads appear in snapshot.inputs too.
helperInterface.probe: session.probe(canonicalRootRelativeFile) -> boolean; anchored nofollow, absence premises/present metadata recorded/revalidated. Unsupported ancestor links throw, do not approximate absence. Leaf link metadata may be recorded without following.
helperInterface.resolve: session.resolve({from,specifier,mode}) -> {file:canonicalRootRelativeTarget,owner:null|{key:logicalRootRelativePackageRoot,manifest:canonicalRootRelativeManifest,body:parsedJSON,workspace:boolean},trace:deterministicResolutionRecord}; no semantic proof/interop/installed trust. Exact isBuiltin refusal FIRST. Relative imports/legacy only repaired conservative v1 subset; new workspace owner/export selection per approved SPEC. Existing v1 self-reference error label UNKNOWN_PACKAGE_SELF_REFERENCE may be preserved.
helperInterface.snapshot: session.snapshot() -> deterministic JSON serializable {profile:RESOLUTION_PROFILE,inputs:[{file,sha256}],...full root/chain/link/inventory/present/absence/file premises, resolutions}; noFD/PID/procpath authority; include rawlinkhash/bytes, relevant generations and paths, all metadata charged. Snapshot must stay identical across same physical immutable input invocations.
helperInterface.revalidate: session.revalidate() -> throws on any premise mutation, else returns true. MUST use anchored acquisition, no unsafe absolute file reads; revalidate even on UNKNOWN. session.close() idempotently closes every owned FD in finally (caller owns finally as well). session.usage gives {fileBytes,totalBytes,files} and new cap usage with stable names chosen by helper.
helperInterface.revalidateResolutionSnapshot: revalidateResolutionSnapshot({root,snapshot,limits}) -> true or throws; new own rootfd reader, strict untrusted snapshot shape/path validation, reacquire/revalidate ALL recorded root/chain/link/inventory/present/absence/file premises, closefinally; no content via unverified symlink, no external paths. Parent uses this after independent worker recomputation and profile/helper hashes. Snapshot cannot be accepted as supplied approval.
